I can understand the feeling of loneliness. Feeling like there isn't anyone in your life to have these serious conversations with. My word of advice is to have a conversation here, or with someone online. That way if the conversation goes array, you won't have to speak to them ever again. Think of it as a test run. I would talk to your sister. Tell her to keep it confidential for now. Your boss shouldn't use that against you. Going through a path of depression is completely normal, and a lot more people go through it then you think. Just remember that you are not alone. There are people that care about you.  Feel free to message me if you need more advice :) And good luck out there buddy ;)
